                            CJP Protest Live

                            Live: CJP-govt 3rd round of talks today; 18 Delhi Metro stations continue to be shut

                            Cockroach Janta Party Nationwide Protest Live Updates: After a day of high political drama, the CJP-led agitation over the alleged NEET paper leak remains on edge as the Centre is set to announce major NTA reforms at 8 pm while another round of talks with protesters is scheduled for Saturday. CJP leaders claimed the government was positive on demands related to compensation and withdrawal of FIRs but sought more time to decide on Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan's resignation. Meanwhile, Rahul Gandhi demanded the Prime Minister apologise over alleged pellet gun injuries to students, several opposition leaders rallied behind the protests, and the CJP warned that any attempt to detain its leaders ahead of the weekend would only intensify the movement. Follow IndiaToday.in for live updates on the CJP protest.
